title: Asking For An Old Friend: Diagnosing and Mitigating Temporal Failure Modes in LLM-based Statutory Question Answering
authors: Max Prior; Andreas Schultz; Matthias Grabmair
why_relevant: Studies temporal knowledge conflict between parametric knowledge and retrieved evidence in legal QA, including recency bias and RAG-based mitigation with temporal filtering. Provides a benchmark for diagnosing failure modes relevant to context compliance and conflict resolution.
why_not_or_caveat: Domain-specific (German statutory law) and narrowly focused on temporal validity rather than broad RAG robustness.
